page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is a storage-focused virtual machine instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance provides 32 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, resulting in 32 vCPUs. It is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a 4.0 GB memory-per-core ratio.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, offering 94489 GB of HDD storage. This high-density storage configuration is paired with a 20 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, facilitating large-scale data transfers. The instance does not include any GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the hardware profile, the ecs.d1ne.8xlarge offers high resource density for storage-heavy workloads, making it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for applications requiring massive local capacity without the premium cost of SSDs. The combination of dedicated CPU cores, balanced memory, and extensive HDD storage makes this instance suitable for large-scale data warehousing, log processing, MapReduce jobs, and cold storage databases.
